notes.title: Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
The texture in the farm section has completely changed. A more lively and beautiful appearance has been made.

The character jump animation has been changed and the jumping power has been reduced.

The bug where sales were made despite there being no items in the inventory in the trade system has been fixed.

The problem that occurred when the trade panel opened with every trigger and created a bad game experience has been fixed.

I attach great importance to feedback and will fix any missing points.

notes.title: Bugs Fixed
notes.notes: Fixed the issue of riding horses on the sky island.

notes.title: Marla
notes.notes: The leader of a union consisting of Lucas' closest friends and assistants. A woman who maintains her hope until the last moment and has the courage to even give her life for this cause. She descends to the world with Lucas. She organizes the people living on the island and triggers a resistance against omega luma. She is really smart.

notes.title: Lucas
notes.notes: The leader of the planet Vega, who received training from martial arts masters at a young age, is the one who will inherit his father's legacy. When Omega Luma engulfs the planet Vega in flames, Lucas lands on Earth with a spaceship, but the experiences he experiences cause him to lose his memory. You must reach the warrior spirit like in the old days, Lucas.

notes.title: Omega Luma
notes.notes: One of the lords of darkness who came from the Luma lineage that lived in ancient times. Their ancestors caused disasters in the universe and with great luck our world remained free from these disasters. Omega Luma wants to reach Lucas' father's secret heritage and treasure and then kill Lucas. So will the Earth be destroyed like the planet Vega?

notes.title: Arthur
notes.notes: He may look weak, but he is a true warrior. He has defeated many enemies one-on-one and is a master of using weapons. Lucas must get help from Arthur. Otherwise, disaster will be inevitable.

notes.title: Andrew
notes.notes: His passion for the sea, which started at a young age, led him to an island under pirate rule. Andrew shows his wisdom to those around him with his experienced and calm nature. If he had received military training, he could even have become a general. Who knows?

notes.title: BILGE
notes.notes: A strange and mysterious woman. The mushrooms she has been dealing with lately have an effect on her brain, and her skills and knowledge are extremely high. Although no one knows when she came to the island, she has a secret of her own.

notes.title: NOAH
notes.notes: He is a funny and honest person. After working as a tourist guide in Europe, he falls into the hands of pirates during a trip and starts to serve them. His intelligent personality and ability to foresee events can help Lucas.
